Meet The Drunken System

Alien administrators discover booze.
Earth gets the hangover.

The Skarn usually give civilizations a carefully tailored RPG System. This time, they’ve discovered human alcohol—and rushed the job.

Now humanity is stuck in a mandatory tutorial built from questionable modules and even worse decisions. To get home, everyone must clear the final raid dungeon while the people in charge keep changing the rules.

The next patch will fix everything.
Probably.

Read more about the book

While humanity tries to survive, the Skarn scramble to rebuild Earth and hide the mess from Corporate. Each fix introduces another problem. Each new problem demands another patch. A bawdy sci-fi LitRPG comedy where humanity’s biggest obstacle may be the people running the System.

The man behind the Systems

FROM BUILDING STEEL MILLS
TO BREAKING SYSTEMS.

Lucent Steele writes speculative fiction about the possibilities—and consequences—of transformation.

Before the books came steel, cars, and international businesses—including a concept for a renewable-powered steel mill. It turns out building a world is another way to ask: what could we do differently?

Sometimes the answer is humanity’s next evolution. Sometimes it’s drunk aliens with administrative privileges.
